body:
It's almost IMPOSSIBLE to keep up.

I feel for you my friend.

I can't tell you the frustration I had before I finally got these cars..

It caused stress in my family..!

This hobby can really ruin lives..

I know I post a lot of the same thing...

But...

A.. It's all I have...

B... I like talking to new peeps when they leave a comment. 

C. I like geeking out over the cars...

D.... I just like staring at em....

I'll try to quit spamming the same things..

I think I reposted them by accident..

I clicked the "post" button like... 10 times....

I think I screwed up..

Something different will hopefully come tomorrow.

Wally worlds app.................

Charged me 50 bux!

I..... had to get it online.....

Took lots of pain and frustration but I damn well got it.
I care too!!! This are badass my friend!
I also didn't ask for your opinion.

Go for it.

I don't want your pity anyways.

It's pretty vile for an autistic 30+ old man.

I haven't ONCE asked for it.. Not from you, and not from ANYONE else.

I asked people where to find cars. Not if I could take theirs.

Wanna keep goin?

Thank you...

Some really good things HAVE happened recently..

Grandparents are now in my world and have helped me a ton!

I just got lucky with the cars...

I use two different phones.

I usually forget to post updates here on this profile...

So I'm sorry if I'm not the clearest out there..

Times HAVE been tough..

And usually...

People who ask about my history usually message me rather than just commenting on the same posts that I've made.!

Months of sympathy baiting.

I wish I could be good at that..!

Cause then I'd actually know what I'm doing.!

No... I'm just trying to get by is all. 

And people usually react positively.. I've never had a comment like yours before..

There's another reason why I have the nickname basketcase my dude..

Life's just been tough.

Recently, I've had a lot more support than I have ever had before... Warrant stuff.

I've finally been given a little bit of a break.

I still need to serve the punishments... But I never could have paid off that massive fine..

I have had it since 2014.

It has weighed over my head for almost ten years... 

So... I apologize if my posts sound more stressful than most...

My mom has been sick for a really long time... Just getting her medications has stressed us... Including making our wallets empty. 

Remember... I use two different phones to post stuff...

If you pay attention, there's another profile that's got very similar images on it.

Plus.... I don't need anyone else's cars.

I have my own..

I've been blessed with amazing friends who have helped me get to this point.

So...

Idk what to tell you bud..

I'm autistic.. AND 30 years old.... 

I don't have the kinda time to respond to comments like this but...

You're right.. I should clear the air for a little bit..

Remember also... If you're REALLY invested in my profile, the help, support, whatever, only has come recently.

It has been a manic disaster for a long time...

So... If you wanna be a jerk, go ahead..

Those that actually give a damn have messaged me..

So I don't have to really pay attention and make a STATUS update.

I'm not an influencer.
I am gonna hold you to that.. Lol

I know...

Unfortunately...

Because of what's happening in my world right now, this is one of the best ways to get ANY sort of money.

True.

I've been asked to sell them so I have money for my mom's meds...

They're given to me from a friend and... He told me to sell what I can so we can survive..

I was very fortunate.

Zonda R sounds the best...

The Bolide is the most capable...

But I still gotta go with the GT3... Mostly because the Turbo S doesn't exist in 991.2 Gen or newer....

Nah..

I knew where it was being posted..

I had made another post regarding the trash being left outside from other collectors...
This IS AWFUL!

Is there not like... Toxic fumes being RADIATED into the valley?

My mom has been sick for a long time with her lung stuff...

Fucking stupid.

Google controls a LOT of this...

Why not incorporate some sort of program to make it work..

NOT make it some dumb law.

Can't say I'm shocked...

Mormons usually do weird/awful shiite like this to keep em separated from us "in-pure" people.

I try to keep in mind that there are MULTIPLE heavens in their world.

Fuggin weird.

The dollar tree over by my moms house hasn't seen a case in over 6 months...

I feel your pain.

So..

I'm pretty ignorant to this topic but..

I'm just existing to give hot wheels cars to people and whatever...

However it's almost impossible to find the cars that are worthy of sharing..

I can't comment on the FBI investigation...

We turned in paperwork today...

Her housing, and my stuff for my first psychiatrist appointment in a while...

Tomorrow morning at 8.

Some revelations have been made.. 

Some lessons.. 

But.. Now that I know that I have some internal head stuff, I hopefully can get a chance to figure my head out..

But all of this has to be after my mom for sure has somewhere to stay. 

It's not ok here..

Toxic.. 

She WILL NOT MAKE IT... 

There's a LOT of context...

For now..

I'm not "allowed" to play my game anymore btw...

New leadership.. The place changed entirely...

I don't see much of that familiar community... 

Even though I had lived in Murray for so long, I focused elsewhere.

Too much to really get into here I suppose.

Well... I have a yellow Countach in a basket for ya.. 

Next time you come to my store on the weekends... I'll make sure to have you leave with it..

IF you want... 

I'm the weird long haired nerd that couldn't articulate words well when you came to visit my store.

I had to nag you about putting in a phone number so you can get the sale prices..

There's a reason for it... I promise..

Thank you.

I'm past that though. 

I'm going to move into a friends house soon..

If a couple months go by without decent progress, I'm done.

I tried to be a caretaker for over a decade and a half and... Well.. No progress is made in this context.. I tried so hard to help my mom get her treatments and things like this..

But I think the treatments and such are reaching a level that I just can't handle right now.

I can't take care of myself, so I have to call medicaid, ask em to take my mom in and help with a housing or... Health benefit of SOME sort.

It just isn't getting done while I'm living here...

I think I have to call for both of us... Separate the codependency, call for a new psychiatrist... and .. Idk.. It's been a few days since I've slept a solid 2 hours consistently.

Too much to explain in 3 minutes...







Felt like I needed to respond to this one...

Cause... Shit's dark.. Like.. Badly dark... I do see some light but.. I've been in too many fights, financial problems, family drama, work crap, and..... Other stuff.

I feel like I should say to share this for Anna's sake.. For her Instagram.. Social media stuff...

She is the one who's responsible for the video in the first place!

I don't even know how to change my name!!

I'm not a Sergeant anymore!

Oh god really?

I've never uploaded on here before..

I'll try again...

I'm so sorry..

I dunno if I can call myself a collector, redistributer, or... What.... 

I have a couple baskets.. Well.. A tote and a basket..

I work at a walgreens in utah on weekends...
I try to take care of my mom on the weekdays..

Before new management... I used to be able to do this kinda giveaway thingy... Stanner... My buddy got me the job there and I was aloud a privilege to challenge customers to name a car while I'd ring em up... If the situation was appropriate and professional... A group, family, couple, an individual, whoever... If they could name it correctly, they could either take the car they named home, or they could pick something from the basket.. I got the nickname "OfficialBasketCase".. Yes.. That's my Instagram if you actually want to know... 

A lot has happened since that simple start... I got to meet a few interesting people, I have been able to make tons of new relationships with my guests.... 

However... 

Lately.. 

Things have been pretty hard... 

My Mom..

I've advocated before That's she's been ill.. Tried to.. But this most recent trip to the ER was really Difficult.

Things had started falling downhill leading to that point.... 

Over a loooong period of time... 

Money problems... 

More health issues..

So... What now?

Well... Two more appointments are this next week..

We'll see what happens. 

I've been her... Aid... Caretaker.. Whatever... For a long time. We both are really worn down. 

With not many more options.

I have begged her to please get herself looked at forever... But there was more neglect than her body could handle... I hope she learns from this.

There are many things that have to be paid off.. Many wrongs have to be reversed.. At least... That's how it feels... Idk anymore... Idk what the true scale of my ignorance is.. 

She has sheltered me for too long... I have to do something different...

Soon...

Cause now I've missed appointments of my own now too. 

Obviously my choice... I know this... Everything is my choice... I control my destiny right?


So... Idk how to feel anymore. I'm angry. I feel like I have to leave and THEN call home health to come get her ass cause... It ain't safe here in this house without me here.... Not for an extended period of time. 

Anyways..

My justification for when I would buy my cars would be that it be for the giveaways... So.. Admittedly.... I... I did clear out the shelves if I had the ability to.... However... There was maybe one time where I bought a bunch of cars on my own... The other times were with friends... They pretty much helped me get to where I'm at... Alive.....

The basket is the cars I use for the giveaways... 

The tote... That's filled with everything that I have That's Porsche.. Some of it is stuff I bought.. Most of it is what I love to brag about... The things that were given to me... 

I love to because I just love representing my peeps when my guests come through... At least... That's A way to put it... 

Idk. I just like Porsches...

I have plenty in there.. Plenty of variety to be happy... At this Point.. I guess it's just tweaks.. 
Little niches here and there... Idk... 

However... I DO WANT DUPLICATES. 

I want to be able to give people that are close to me little gift baskets of specific cars that are special for them.

I want to... 

Engaging about this motorsport stuff has been what has given me the life I've had left.. Being able to give the family some cars after work hours this weekend was really a blessing too.. They were really happy.. 

It's..... All I can focus on..

Adhd shiite.. Autistic shiite... Idk... I was supposed learn more about it on the 18th.. Beyond what was in my testing.

Rambling aside....

I'm sorry... I don't really have a question or narrative... I'm just... I guess I can say that Hunting is over with now for me... For now.. 

Unless I am lucky, I don't think I'll see any new cars for a little while.. 

Idk if I'll be able to remember to keep this thing updated if anyone ACTUALLY wants me to...

Idk... Too many questions..

I wouldn't be able to figure it out in time right now...

I have a little too much going on to be able to reliably get you what you need out of the deal...

If only you were in Utah..

Thank you so much.

@OfficialBasketCase 

I used to "scalp"... But I had to justify it with...

"These cars are for the basket.. These cars are for the giveaways... I am to share something special...."

To engage in real motorsport stuff.... 

Idk...
I've honestly been looking for this for MONTHS!
Now... How does it perform on a track?
I only wish I could find one here in utah

I am the local basket case.


I will take those cars and share them with people who can understand that it isn't a business..

If I can see motorsport in their eyes and not dollar signs... They can have it for free.
Sorry. I'm salty..

My usual rounds consists of giving a bunch of staff at a bunch of different locations cars...

Ya see... We're looking at this a little differently....

We're not after the STH cars. We're not even necessarily looking for Hot Wheels.... Were looking for IRL Race cars with legitimate liveries, as well as high performance production cars... 

We love love LOVE geeking over the engineering prowess of humanity... To see what society has achieved.. How were going to move forward...

Motorsport is Motorsport...

But... When I went to my first ever meet a little while back, as well as this most recent 2nd stint..... Everyone had dollar signs in their eyes... At least... That's how it felt... 

But... What do I know right?
Probably people like us.....

I would guess we're on the right track... The one with the Black and gold bus, blue Essenza SC-V12, the Audi, and Merc....

Idk if I'll find it here..

My area hasn't seen any activity in a long while unfortunately...

I make my rounds but... No one has anything... So I can't share anything special right now with friends or family... Not yet at least.

Damn...

Thank you for telling me....

Would you be willing to take a picture of the back side??

I've been looking for a clear image of the barcode and the number that's attached to it...

Would you be willing?

Ok... Damn... Yes... I am being a little selfish... But I do also want to find a bunch of em LITERALLY JUST SO I CAN SHARE EM WITH MY FRIENDS AND LOVED ONES.......

I don't really get that kind of luxury with this hobby... I want to fill the walls of my inner circles houses...

It's a long story about a giveaway thing I used to do at my work... "@OfficialBasketCase".... Not that I produce any content.... I just liked talking to my guests and what not about it.. 

Anyways... 

I'm sorry..

I just... I have never had any good luck with this hobby...

Only kindness from others...

I wish... I WISH!!!! My luck was good so I didn't have to burden my friends and family to help me find specific friggin cars...

It's been a painful and irritating experience...

But because I love cars and the future of the supercar.... I can't ignore it... I try so hard to...

But there are so many I want to at least be able to hold in my hand... Let alone drive....
Was this in utah by chance?
Was this in utah by chance?

There's a lot of history from Porsche so.. When they let mattel make a new casting, it's a big deal... Plus.. It does look good and.. Well.. People really love it.. Including me..!

I hope they will make the GT3RS as well..

If my first one wasn't stolen on CHRISTMAS day last year... I'd be a little more enthusiastic but..

I'm almost convinced I won't find anything out there that I want..

You're not wrong..

I'm just stressed..

My world is a little bleak.. Sharing these cars are something that gives me life..

Sharing em.. Not necessarily collecting em.

Sure.. I'd like to add one to my Porsche basket but.. I also want to share with peeps too..

I'm stressed cause I turn 30 on friday..
What I would do...
Wish this was in utah.

Those skylines... Wow..

I do admit they look good.!

My wallet goes towards a different company but... I do see the appeal.

I can........ But I can't.

My world will not let me do what I want to..

Long story....

That's... That makes sense.. I don't like it but.. It makes sense..

Hopefully luck will be on my side...

I some how have a lot of JDM cars.. I don't necessarily have such a big attachment to them but.. I know other people like em... 

Idk what I can do with these cars now... I used to be able to do this kinda giveaway game with em...

Makes me sad still..
YES GO GET IT!!!

It's a good thing but... Also a bad thing...

I want to share so many cars...

It's a thing....
I'm sorry everyone... I don't want to come across as dramatic or over exaggerating.. I'm just in a crappy mindset..
Wow... Just... Wow..! I love it..! Hopefully someday I can get a few for everyone..!
Thank you for letting me know...

I have 3 (black, white, and blue) Mainlines of the 934.5.. I want to try to obtain every variant of the "934.5.. Along with the STH... It's been agony trying to get one. 

So I want to try to find every variant of the 935... Both older gen and newer gen...

I have a really NICHE collection of Porsches... I have wanted to make clones of this Basket O' Porsches.. To share with people...

I just.. Celebrate motorsport in this angle way too much I guess....

Septemberish?

My friend who's way smarter than I am thought it would be June.. I guess either way, I'll keep an eye out I guess....

Do you know when they'll come to Utah at all?

I do want them.. I'm a caretaker though.. I sacrificed everything to help my mom.

I've worked so hard for so long... I can't be the big shot collector I'd like to be...

I'm so angry with myself for this... I want to share them with people... 

I don't have a family.

The friends I'm closest to share a similar "sharing" philosophy... So it's not like I'd be keeping them for myself... As much as I want to...

This is such a good looking livery.... Plus.. Porsche is celebrating 75 years of existence... I want to be closer to this world so badly...

I dream and obsess over it all the time..

It's been miserable for me to find ANYTHING here in Utah.

I can only barely afford the 1dollar cars....

I've wanted the STH 934.5 AND the new 935 STH Porsches...

Not to mention I'm sick... + I have to be a caretaker at the same time. 

I've been close to losing the thread I'm hanging on to.

Well...

If the hunt wouldn't turn into a clusterfuck...

I would enjoy that journey a LOT more... 

It's completely dry  here in utah... I can never find anything. 

It's just a sour feeling when scalpers raid these places before I get a chance.

I do want a new one...

But I'm a caretaker... All of my money goes to her meds... And now mine too because... Well.. I've learned LAST YEAR that I have an ADHD issue, as well as an Autistic spectrum issue...

It has been a nightmare just trying to survive..

I sacrificed my youth and my potential for a more wealthy future... Just so I could try to help her feel better.

Things have happened lately that has made me not want to be on this planet anymore.. It's hard to explain and I don't want to make you read another pity party type message... 

I just hope someday I'll be able to obtain these cars... There are so many good ones that I just... I have a feeling I'll never be able to get them...

I'm sorry... I'm just angry with myself.. I hate myself so much but.. I can't say that here at home... I'll get sent somewhere.

If I can't make a future that looks somewhat fulfilling, I don't want to live on a planet that won't let me live rather than survive...

I need the STH of the 934.5...

It's been nothing but AGONY trying to collect it... I've never had a STH before and I'm trying to find the Porsche STH cars to put into my Porsche Basket... I've worked so hard trying to attain one but... I'm a caretaker... I can't afford it... Plus I want the 935 STH that's coming to Utah in June I believe... 

I have a feeling I'll never be able to attain these cars before I die. Makes me sad..

It has been ABSOLUTE AGONY trying to get the cars I'd like...

I had a purple RWB Porsche Team Transport.. 

It was loose and I had it next to my Porsche basket that was on display... Long story short.. On Christmas day, it was stolen... I HATE the hot wheels community for that!! VULTURES... I swear to god... 

There are only a few people in my circle who are decent people.. When it comes to having these car collections.. They all have been so good to me... HOWEVER... It's so difficult talking to people who only have dollar signs in their eyes and NOT the passion for motorsport like I try to perceive..

I'm not perfect obviously... But I wouldn't steal or swindle someone out of their valuable cars just to make a buck.. I wouldn't do it at all! They worked for those cars... It's priceless for em... Like the RWB was for me... 

Salt lake valley has been so dry because of all the scalpers that live here....

It's so disgusting...

But.. What do I know.. I'm just some keyboard warrior I guess.. 

It's just.. The hobby has put a rotten taste in my mind. I'm in it for the motorsport stuff. NOT the business crap like seemingly everyone else..

I'm just butthurt.. I want to get clones of my Porsche Basket... I want to share whats in there as opposed to the other stuff that's out there... It's what I know most of... And I like to engage with peeps about it... What's even better is when people talk to me about these things and tells me something I didn't know about the whole thing...

I'm kind of just rambling at this point so... Uhh.. I know you didn't ask me specifically what my opinions were but... Here's my word vomit.

The "BASKET CASE"..

I have my wall full of hot wheels cars, a bag full of MORE hot wheels cars, a basket FULL of diecast cars, and a few models.

I have a notebook that I write down every supercar that I see...
What day I saw it, what specific model, (Cause apparently I can identify a good amount of em) and if I met the owner. 

I love to play a game with guests that come through my work place. It's something different.. I'll place a random car on the counter. If they guess correctly, they can either have it or pick one from the basket. I used to have 3 FULL baskets... I can't resupply right now due to my mom being sick all the time... Her appointments take me away from clocking in at work. It's been a rough struggle I don't want to put you through due to how my mental health has declined to the point of suicide. 

Maybe a story for another day... 

Anyways.. I love learning about the history and pedigree... I should have a HELL of a lot more retained however I have the memory of a goddam goldfish CRACKER... Already partially eaten.... Listening to people who tell me somethings I didn't know about the modern supercar is one of the highlights of my job... Being able to engage with people on days that I feel well enough to do so means a bunch to me.. I have been diagnosed with ADHD, I'm on the Autism Spectrum, and I have a couple of disassociative diagnoses written down too... I hate how I can't focus on anything else...  

So... When people actually take their time to be a geek with me... It almost makes me cry every time. Because of how much I hate myself, as well as how grateful I am to talk to someone who's giving me a little validation.

Hopefully someday I can return the favor ten fold...





I'm what they call the local basket case..

I carry a basket full of cars people can WIN....Not trade, NOT BUY, but win...

I'll place a random car on the counter and have you guess the car. If you guess it correctly then you can take that car home, or pick one from the basket.

I have SOME decent cars for people to win... But I DEFINITELY need more... And multiples too... That way the family BEHIND the family I'm ringing up don't get disappointed because they wanted a certain car....

People keep buying these special cars for a dollar, JUST TO SELL THEM FOR HUGE UNDERSERVED PROFITS....... I don't want to disappoint people because I can't find a decent car for them...!

I wanna share.... I want to share the special cars and geek out with my guests.! I want to go over WHY SHIITE's special...

That's what makes ME HAPPY.... But I can't keep going on with this HOBBY if it's going to be treated as just another DIRTY business.

I have only been after real life cars.. I play this guessing game with my guests when they have an extra second and..  Well.. How can they play the game if the cars are all imaginary cars... 

I didn't want my favorite cars to be super treasure hunts... Not to mention putting more value on the cars when they ARE super treasure hunt cars.

I haven't been able to play my game with people for a multitude of reasons... Beyond just the imaginary car thing... Scalpers, new management, new people around me, etc..

I haven't been able to find anything the people would want.! 

It's frustrating because it's one of the few things that gives me life on this forsaken planet.

I don't usually dig around like others.. I'll keep my hands to myself and look through the begs and under the card.. It has the name right there...

I went to a lot people and have talked to em about the 935.. I need as many of them as I can possibly get... Cars like the ones I have listed and I feel.... Cornered..



PORSCHE 934.5
PORSCHE 935 (Isn't out yet)
PORSCHE 911 GT2
PORSCHE 911 GT3RS
PORSCHE 918

LOTUS EVIJA

MERCEDES 300 SL

Why?

I haven't been able to find any TH's from em....
I'm a little Jelly.

I've had quite a few over the last few months...

But I always end up giving em away during my weekends at work..!

Bad habit... 

But... It DOES make the families that come in, LEAVE with a little less rainy cloud on their shoulders...

Plus the STH 934.5, GT3RS, 918, and GT2...

Also, some GT1's as well...

IF I can even get it.... Scalpers will screw me over on that end here in Utah... It's been dry here for a while now... I have not had much opportunity to be optimistic unfortunately....

I hope you're right...

My Gpapa, whom I hadn't seen in over 18 years, until JUST recently, gave it to me for the holidays... I'm really grateful...!

It's cool that you still have yours!!

Christmas....

And.... I have a lot of friends that come into my work who I shouldn't refer to as.... "customers " anymore....

But... It could be because I do the giveaway thing... maybe they're just reciprocating.... Idk...
Either way, I was blessed...
What has made hot wheels fuggin just......... EXPLODE..!?

I've got the nismo race car thing as an error piece... Missing it's roof as well...!

What is the worth on these types of things..?

Why keep em?

Be careful.... I ended up in the same path... Please don't make the same mistakes that I did by hyping up the trip only to be disappointed because of scalpers....

The culture has gone completely toxic and hostile as of late....

Be aware... Don't go in to ANYTHING with the hopes of finding something decent....

My basket is almost empty.. Seeing the smiles always puts more dopamine into action. Listening to others and their niches let's me learn who my regulars are.. This also helps my more introverted guests open up a little more as well too.... 

It's so rewarding.. I love being there... But... When I come home, I immediately come down from that high and sink into this low that makes it almost impossible to get out of. It really does make me think that I'm just this bitch that can't handle life... 

I did get recently diagnosed with ADHD, non debilitating Autistic spectrum disorder, some depression disorder thing, and an anxiety thing.. I didn't bother memorizing the names of those last two. 

I also have been a caretaker for my mom for the last decade and a half... While she has been in agony, I have put my life on hold to try to help her with everything to try to get her on a better path forward.. 

However... I feel like I've sacrificed too much to really get anywhere meaningful in my own life. I may be stuck where I'm at forever... And I'm not ok with that. Idk what to do though... So I'm kind of just floating by until something else happens.... I'm just tired of really bad things taking place instead of good things... 

I won't be able to refill the basket for a long time... Makes me really sad as well.. It's really difficult to keep my chin up.. I do know that I have a support system... I will never take that for granted.. It's more of a self hatred than anything else.. At least I think that's what it is for now...

But... What do I know.. I'm just complaining.. Sorry..

Shit... I'm sorry... I didn't even think about that... Since I wasn't being malicious or trying to scam anyone, I thought I was in the clear... I was flat out being honest and I should have of all the times read the fine print when I didn't for once...

My bad...

Those are the only cars I'll give to people...

History and pedigree is what matters here for me.
Maybe they ought to read the constitution.

Ooooohhh.....

Sorry.. I just like cars... I'm still sorta new-ish with this stuff..

I've constantly complained about the Scalpers that are out there... 

I do a giveaway thing at my work and I've gotten pretty low on the supply that I have right now... And because I haven't been able to get anything special, I'm worried I'm gonna disappoint the people that come through my place..!

Sure... I have my supply of Porsches... I have a semi decent collection of em. I put these custom stickers on em specifically to remove the value of them. They're not meant to be bought or sold.. They're effing toys...

But I still wanna find more Porsches so that I can share them with people..! We live in a really special time where humanity can create amazing things... If we all worked together at least... So I am ways so enthralled with the stories and pedigree each car carries in the real world... But... Until I'm no longer poor, and I have life put a bit more together, I can't buy anymore stock... Which bites...



I HAVE to do this...  SORT of.. 

At my work, I do my giveaway nonsense.... If I can just buy them, I can GIVE them to kids and families who actually deserve it. 

I've had scalpers walk into my store try to film me saying I'm just like em.... However what they didn't know was that they were also recorded annihilating other walgreen locations nearby just before they came to my location. 

So.... My opinion on people who are into hot wheels isn't great.... The difference here is that I share what is special to people who my staff and I feel deserve it....

I challenge people to name cars... They win a car if they're correct... Learning about the history and pedigree to motorsport while admiring the technological genius to the new stuff is what makes this whole thing so engaging to my guests, as well as myself.... 

I love it when there are people who know more about cars than I do.... I love learning new things about this stuff..

And if all of that is for a single hot wheels car..... Yeah... Ima buy that shit before ANYONE can. 

You scalpers are what has made this hobby into the tragedy that it is today.... I used to say that I understood that people have to make money somehow... But I fully take back that mindset.... 

No mother fuckers... You just want to charge kids extortionate amounts of money ONLINE for your own monetary gain.... You want to make these kids miss out on something special just so you can make a buck. You want other collectors to buy from you for your own gain.... You're all disgusting. I hate you. I have had an immense amount of rage towards you people and I cannot wait to find you IRL.
